current_evidence: The council's 'Apply for planning permission' page (last modified 15 June 2026) links to 'Validation guidance - National and local list (PDF, 534 KB)' as 'our local list validation guidance document'; the PDF cover says '[Adopted March 2016]' and no newer list or review consultation was found.

issues.detail: Grokbot's 'Validation list URL' is the generic 'Apply for planning permission' web page, not the local list itself. The page loads fine, so the Status 'Link only (not readable: blocked/404/login)' is wrong. The actual list is a PDF linked from that page and should have been followed and read.
issues.evidence: Page text: 'Validation guidance - National and local list (PDF, 534 KB)' ... 'our local list validation guidance document'

issues.detail: List date, Date basis and 'Outdated (>2y)?' are all blank. The list states it was adopted in March 2016, so the date should be 2016-03 and the outdated flag should be Yes (about 10 years old).

Grokbot captured 0 requirements (empty tab, '(none)' for every application type), but the PDF's local list has 29 items. Missed items with their triggers: Affordable Housing Statement (site over 0.5ha or net 15+ dwellings); Agricultural Workers Dwelling info (new rural agricultural worker dwelling, or varying an agricultural occupancy tie); Air Quality Assessment (within/adjacent to an AQMA or could raise air quality concerns); Biodiversity/Ecology survey and report (major development, conversion/demolition of redundant buildings, impact on wildlife/designated sites, loss of more than 20ha of BMV land, minerals/waste restoration, EIA development); Building for Life assessment (all major housing); Coal Mining Risk Assessment (non-householder applications in Coal Mining high-risk areas); Energy/Sustainability Statement (5+ dwellings or 500 sq m+ non-residential); Environmental Statement (EIA Schedule 1/2); Flood Risk Assessment (over 1ha in Flood Zone 1; new buildings, changes of use or extended ground cover in FZ2/3); Heritage Statement (site within or adjoining a listed building, conservation area, historic park/garden, scheduled monument or archaeological interest); Land Contamination (contamination known/suspected or nearby: screening report or Phase 1); Landscaping Scheme (all major applications); Lighting Assessment (external lighting near housing, a listed building, a conservation area or open countryside); Loss of Employment info; Noise Impact Assessment (noise-sensitive development or development that may cause noise); Open Space Assessment (loss of open space, playing fields, recreation grounds or allotments); Parking information; Planning Obligations/Draft Heads of Terms (major development or where an obligation is needed); Statement of Community Involvement (strategic major: 200+ dwellings/4ha+ residential, 10,000 sq m+ commercial, 2ha+ commercial land, wind farms of 2+ turbines, turbines over 15m); Structural Survey (rural building conversions; demolition of listed buildings or buildings in conservation areas); SuDS (more than 10 dwellings or equivalent); Telecommunications (masts not permitted development); Town Centre sequential/impact test (retail/leisure over 2,500 sq m outside a town centre); Transport Assessment/Statement (major development with significant transport implications); Travel Plan (significant trip generators, e.g. 2,500 sq m+ non-residential); Tree Survey/Arboricultural Statement (semi-mature/mature trees on or next to the site, TPO or conservation-area trees, protected hedgerows); Foul Sewage and Utilities Assessment (all strategic applications); Ventilation and Extraction Statement (A3/A4/A5 uses or extraction/air-conditioning equipment); Waste Management/Storage and Collection Plan (strategic major; 10+ dwellings for refuse collection; most new development).

summary: Grokbot's link is the council's generic 'Apply for planning permission' page, not the list. It loads fine (not blocked) and links to the only local list, the validation guidance PDF adopted March 2016. Grokbot recorded no date and none of the list's 29 local requirements.
